title: Agent eval suite
description: Run the agent eval suite (ADR-0019): headless Claude Code, with only the Ndop MCP server and a subscription token in CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, carries out each prompt in a copy of a fixture app; ndop verify and the prompt's required components score it.

prompts.description: Prompt ids to run, such as 1,7; every prompt when left out.

repeat.description: Attempts per prompt, to measure variance.

resume.description: Continue the report in reportDir from the first unfinished prompt.

minAccuracy.description: Fail under this share of passing attempts.

angular.description: Angular CLI version for the fixture app.

promptsFile.description: The suite's prompts, relative to the workspace root.

reportDir.description: Report folder, relative to the workspace root.

workDir.description: Scratch folder for the fixture and the copies.
